system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: It empowers users to rapidly build and execute customized multi-agent systems through simple configuration.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are defined per node in the YAML config, with ${VAR} placeholders. The render code was not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Depends on the workflow; the evidence does not show a default.

context_compaction.note: Tree-mode reduction exists, but it is a workflow feature, not history compaction.

observation_format.note: Message blocks also support image, audio and video, but it is unclear whether these are tool observations.

tool_count.note: Tools are configured per node; no default tool list is shown.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Tooling**: Execution environment bound to agent nodes (Function or MCP implementations).
tool_schema_source.note: How Function-tool schemas are produced is not shown (see functions/).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Function/MCP modes, context injection, built-in function catalog, MCP launch patterns.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: DAG/cyclic graph execution, Tarjan cycle detection, super node construction, recursive cycle execution.
loop_primitives.note: Workflows are YAML graphs, including cyclic ones. Map/tree dynamic parallel execution is also reachable. event_driven rests only on WebSocket event streaming, which is weak evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Parses YAML DAGs, coordinates `model`, `python`, `tooling`, and `human` nodes inside a shared context
multi_agent_topology.note: The topology is user-defined per workflow. The shipped workflows, e.g. ChatDev_v1.yaml, are role pipelines.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Parses YAML DAGs, coordinates `model`, `python`, `tooling`, and `human` nodes inside a shared context
delegation_mechanism.note: Subgraph nodes may also allow spawning sub-workflows.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Initiate workflows, monitor real-time logs, inspect intermediate artifacts, and provide human-in-the-loop feedback.
human_in_loop.note: Human nodes can be placed anywhere in the workflow graph.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Memory list architecture, built-in `simple`/`file`/`blackboard` behaviors, embedding config, troubleshooting.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Memory list architecture, built-in `simple`/`file`/`blackboard` behaviors, embedding config, troubleshooting.
long_term_memory.note: Also present: .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md and entity/configs/node/skills.py. Memory is opt-in per node, and persistence across runs is not confirmed.

state_persistence.note: The README warns that restarts lose progress: 'interrupts tasks and loses progress'.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Reasoning enhancement, self-reflection mode, extending custom thinking modes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Agent, Python, Human, Subgraph, Passthrough, Literal, Loop Counter node configurations.
termination_condition.note: Loop counter and loop timer nodes can bound cycles. Graph completion ends the run.

timeouts.note: A loop_timer node exists (docs/user_guide/en/nodes/loop_timer.md), but its contents are not shown.

execution_isolation.note: Docker Compose is an alternative way to deploy the whole app.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Shared directory for Python nodes at `WareHouse/<session>/code_workspace/`, synchronized with relevant attachments.
filesystem_access.note: A workspace directory exists, but no enforcement of it is shown.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Set `API_KEY` and `BASE_URL` in `.env` for your LLM provider.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Tooling**: Execution environment bound to agent nodes (Function or MCP implementations).

tracing.evidence_quote: WebSocket pushes states, logs, and artifact events; JSON logs stay in `logs/`, and `WareHouse/` stores run assets.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Checks all YAML files for syntax and schema errors.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark runner appears in the evidence; only YAML validation. The file tree was truncated at 400 of 604 paths.

target_domain.evidence_quote: orchestrate complex scenarios such as data visualization, 3D generation, and deep research.

open_source.evidence_quote: No coding is required—users can define agents, workflows, and tasks
open_source.note: A LICENSE file exists, but its text was not shown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: layer encapsulates OpenAI, Gemini, and other APIs so each node can swap models, base URLs, credentials
